name: moneypal-workspace
description: MoneyPal 的 DSH 与 MCP npm 包工作区。

scripts.build:base: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-bridge.mjs && node scripts/build-client-bundle.mjs && node --check dist/src/client.bundle.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:base && node scripts/build-release-packages.mjs && node scripts/build-expert.mjs
scripts.test:fast:built: node --test dist/test/batches.test.js dist/test/client-core.test.js dist/test/client-bundle.test.js dist/test/init-ledger.test.js dist/test/install-preset.test.js dist/test/register-contract.test.js dist/test/statements-contract.test.js
scripts.test:fast: npm run build:base && npm run test:fast:built
scripts.test:integration:built: node --test dist/test/batches.test.js dist/test/client-core.test.js dist/test/client-bundle.test.js dist/test/init-ledger.test.js dist/test/install-preset.test.js dist/test/register-contract.test.js dist/test/statements-contract.test.js dist/test/balance-host.test.js dist/test/bridge-process.test.js dist/test/cli.test.js dist/test/confirmed-write.test.js dist/test/dsh-plugin.test.js dist/test/mcp.test.js dist/test/write-interruption.test.js dist/test/beancount-runtime.test.js dist/test/write-runtime.test.js dist/test/statements-runtime.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:base && npm run test:integration:built
scripts.test:release:built: node --test dist/test/package-split.test.js dist/test/release-gates.test.js dist/test/expert-package.test.js dist/test/install-preset.test.js dist/test/release-tarballs.test.js dist/test/publish-release.test.js dist/test/release-promote.test.js dist/test/release-workflows.test.js
scripts.pack:check: npm run build && npm run pack:check:built
scripts.release:tarballs: npm run build && npm run release:tarballs:built
scripts.test:release: npm run build && npm run verify:release:built
scripts.publish:dsh: npm run build && npm publish ./dist/packages/dsh-moneypal --access public --tag next
scripts.publish:mcp: npm run build && npm publish ./dist/packages/mcp-moneypal --access public --tag next
